title: Crash-Safe Saga with Compensations
signature: def run_saga(saga_id, steps, services, journal, clock, max_comp_attempts=3) / def resume_saga(saga_id, steps, services, journal, clock, max_comp_attempts=3)
hints: run_saga is resume_saga on an empty journal. Write one function that rebuilds the state from journal.records() and continues from there.
The idempotency key must be the same on every run: saga_id + ':' + step. A key that changes after a crash charges the card twice.
Compensate only steps that have a step_done record, newest first. The step that failed never happened, so there is nothing to undo.
A comp_started without comp_done or comp_failed means the process died mid-undo. Undo again (cancel is idempotent), with a fresh attempt budget.
